messages:
sam: starting rollout for llm-route v3 behind feature flag `ff.llmroute.v3` — plan: 0% -> 5% over 15m, canary regions eu-west + us-central. deploy-bot: rollout started id=rb-172945 (details: https://releases/internal/rb-172945)

olivia: plan acked. tina, can you run the cohort pin for eu-west? want v2 pinned for 30m while we watch.
tina: running now: `deploy-bot pin-cohort --cohort=eu-west --service=llm-route --version=v2 --ttl=30m`
deploy-bot: cohort pin applied (pin_id=pin-721)

erin: dashboards configured: latency_p50/p95, error_rate, gen_time_by_seq_len. alert thresholds p95>2000ms or error_rate>1%

jen: make sure v3 pool concurrency limit is set low (10 per node) to avoid saturation. sam: limit applied.

olivia: noticing a small bump in 502s on v3 at 07:06 UTC — 0.4% -> 0.9% over 3m, primarily from requests with seq_length>1000.
sam: pausing ramp. deploy-bot: pause rollout rb-172945 (reason: error spike)

tina: looking at traces, seems like KV cache thrash on v3 when seq >1024; kernel path may be hitting a slower fallback.
erin: recommend draining v3 and fail back to v2 for non-canary cohorts while we triage.
sam: initiating quick rollback to v2 for weighted traffic. deploy-bot: initiating rollback rb-172945 -> v2
deploy-bot: rollback complete (rb-172945) — traffic reverted to v2, ramps cleared

jen: confirm pins: remove global canary pin but keep eu-west pin until follow-up? tina: removed global canary pin, leaving pin-721 in place.
olivia: I'll collect anomalies and a minimal repro. initial hypothesis: regression in quantized kernel path under long-sequence jobs.
erin: filing postmortem and adding release-note: "v3 rollout paused due to KV-cache regressions on long-sequence workloads; rolled back to v2; investigating."
sam: next steps: tina to open perf bug with traces, erin to update release notes and deploy ticket, jen to plan a narrower staged re-run (1% traffic, seq<=512) after fix. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: ticket updated: https://issues/internal/ISSUE-1345 (status: triage)
olivia: ping me to re-open ramp after validated fix.
erin: closing thread; follow-ups tracked in ISSUE-1345.
